thread:
maria: FYI grafana alerting is blowing up for the token-econ dashboard (TTFT + tokens/sec + per-token-cost). lots of p95 noise from west2 GPU pool since last night. link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/token-econ

ajay: saw that spike around 22:14 UTC too. was there a deploy or scale event?

lena: no deploys in the window. I checked kube events, there were transient pod restarts on shard-west2-3. KV cache hitrate dropped from ~92% -> 54% which explains token/sec drop and latency bump.

devon: can you share the promql you used to slice by gpu_pool? I want to add a panel showing tokens/sec per GPU + avg cost/token.

lena: sure, paste of quick queries:```promql
// tokens/sec per gpu_pool
sum(rate(inference_tokens_produced_total[1m])) by (gpu_pool)

// p95 per gpu_pool
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,gpu_pool))

// cost per token (approx)
(sum(inference_gpu_cost_usd_total) by (gpu_pool) / sum(rate(inference_tokens_produced_total[1m])) by (gpu_pool))
```

chris: the current alert rule is pretty simple and flaps when cache hits oscillate:```yaml
- alert: TokenLatencyHigh
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.2
  for: 5m
  labels: {severity: page}
```

maria: yeah that's the one. it's too aggressive and doesn't handle the tokens/sec backpressure pattern. we should move to staged alerts and include tokens/sec or cache-hit as a suppression.

ajay: propose: warning when p95>150ms for 15m OR tokens/sec drops >20% for 10m; critical when p99>300ms for 5m AND tokens/sec < 60% of baseline. also add annotation to the panel with last deploy + node-restarts.

devon: I like the two-stage approach. Also add a rate-of-change guard to reduce flapping: e.g. only fire if change > 30% over 5m.

lena: I'll add a histogram panel broken out by gpu_pool+shard and tag hotspots. that will help root cause whether it's network or kvcache.

maria: actionable plan:
- lena: add histograms + tokens/sec per GPU, with link to shard logs (ETA 2h)
- ajay: add deploy/node-restart annotations to dashboard + event query (ETA 1h)
- maria: update alert rule to staged thresholds + tokens/sec suppression and add a runbook link (I'll PR in 30m)
- devon: create a small cost panel that computes usd/token and a 7d trend (ETA tomorrow)

chris: can we also tag the alert with pool-owner and add optional paging only for critical? we should avoid waking on noisy warnings.

maria: yes — warnings go to #eng-sre, critical pages on-call. will add labels: pool_owner, alert_tier.

alertbot: incident-annotate: TokenLatencyHigh alert fired 2026-03-17T22:14:33Z on shard-west2-3 (auto-silenced after 17m)

ajay: one more ask — include per-request tokens histogram for the dashboard so teams can filter by long-sequence workloads (llm-chat vs embedder). that'll help separate cost spikes from tail latency.

lena: good call, adding per-request token distribution panel and a quick filter for model_family and request_type.

maria: thanks team. i'll open the PR for alert changes and add the new dashboard panels as a draft. we'll review in triage tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

chris: if anything flares after the PR we'll rollback within the hour. can someone own post-change monitoring?

devon: i'll run a 2hr smoke after the change and post snapshots in the thread.

maria: perfect. tagging owners in the TODOs in the PR and linking this thread. closing loop here.
